_README: EXAMPLE rollout plan (fictional 'Acme ERP' program). Built from curriculum-architect/examples/curriculum.example.json — wave modules reference those module ids. No confirmed dates: everything anchors on weeks-before-go-live; multi-go-live spacing uses offset_weeks (GL-1 = 0).

go_lives.label: Acme ERP go-live — Phase 1 (Retail, Finance, Supply Chain HQ)
Acme ERP go-live — Phase 2 (remaining retail regions)

waves.name: Super-user enablement (train-the-trainer)
waves.notes: Must complete before any population wave opens.

waves.name: Supply chain planners — planning discipline
waves.notes: Longest runway — net-new discipline, largest gap.

waves.name: Finance analysts — automated posting
waves.notes: Schedule outside the month-end close window.

waves.name: Retail team leads — replenishment confidence
waves.notes: Coaching band continues past go-live (mindset-driven need).

waves.name: Retail frontline — POS ready
waves.notes: On-shift delivery; last so it's fresh at go-live. Requires in-app guidance overlay built by GL−2 wks.

waves.name: Phase 2 super-user enablement (train-the-trainer)
waves.notes: Super-users-first applies per go-live: must complete before any Phase 2 population wave opens.

waves.name: Phase 2 retail frontline — POS ready
waves.notes: Same on-shift pattern as W4, anchored to GL-2.

super_user_plan.selection_criteria: Respected peer, strong on current process, volunteers preferred over voluntolds; coverage across all BUs and shifts.
super_user_plan.role_at_golive: Floor/desk support during cutover week; first escalation point before the help desk.
super_user_plan.role_after: Local coaching (the 20% social band), new-hire onboarding support, feedback channel into the CIA update loop.

comms_touchpoints.message: Your training is coming — what, when, and why it matters

comms_touchpoints.channel: Manager huddles; printed schedule for no-email frontline

comms_touchpoints.message: You're go-live ready — where to get help (super-users, job aids, help desk)

criteria: POS task check passed (both refund types unassisted)
readiness_criteria.gate: Must pass before floor access at go-live
Counted ready when observation criteria on track

criteria: Scenario assessment passed (4 of 5 seeded exceptions)
readiness_criteria.gate: Must pass before running a live cycle unsupervised
Ready for first live close with peer review

program_gates.gate: Sponsor message on why replenishment suggestions are trusted (comms, not training)
Override-accountability decision confirmed with Ops leadership

gates: In-app guidance overlay deployed to Phase 2 terminals

deferred_modules.reason: Phase 2 team-lead cohort deferred until the override-accountability decision (non-training gate) clears — Phase 1 cohort runs in W3 as planned.

measurement.label: Learning
measurement.method: Curriculum assessments (task check / scenario / quiz / observation)

measurement.label: Behavior
measurement.metric: System use vs. workaround (refunds in POS, suggestions approved vs. overridden, cycles run on time)

measurement.label: Results
measurement.metric: Stockout rate; inventory turns; days to close
measurement.method: Business data vs. baseline (baselines PLACEHOLDER — confirm with benefit owners)

reinforcement.activity: Spaced microlearning: refund edge cases + exception triage refresher
Super-user community of practice — first retro; harvest issues into the CIA update loop
Override-pattern review with team leads; targeted coaching where trust lags
New-hire onboarding path (critical for high-turnover frontline); job-aid upkeep owned by L&D

risks_assumptions: Sandbox environment must be ready by GL−7 wks or the experiential 70% band slips (dependency flag).
In-app guidance overlay must be built by GL−2 wks for the frontline wave.
Headcounts, locations, and facilitator names are PLACEHOLDER — confirm before scheduling.
Peak planning season may compress the planner window — confirm the season calendar.
GL-2 offset (GL-1 + 8 weeks) is planning spacing, not a confirmed date — re-anchor if the phase plan moves.
